dialogue.content: ご相談をありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30代　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: 本日は、どのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 生きるのに疲れました
dialogue.English: I’m exhausted from living.

dialogue.content: それは、大変おつらいですね。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 疲れると思うにいたるまで、頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: You must have been trying so hard to have reached this point of exhaustion.

dialogue.content: もし宜しければ、もう少しこれまでのことをもう少し具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you tell me a bit more specifically about what's been going on?

dialogue.content: 育児と家事の毎日に疲れてしまって、
dialogue.English: I'm just so exhausted from the daily routine of childcare and housework...

dialogue.content: はい（聞いています）
dialogue.English: I see. (I’m listening.)

dialogue.content: 生きてる意味があるのかわからなくなりました
dialogue.English: I've started to wonder if there's any meaning to being alive.

dialogue.content: 育児と家事の毎日なのですね、お休みがないですよね。
dialogue.English: So it's the daily grind of childcare and housework, with no breaks, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, there aren't.

dialogue.content: お子様は何歳ですか？
dialogue.English: How old is your child?

dialogue.content: 1歳です
dialogue.English: One year old.

dialogue.content: お一人ですか？
dialogue.English: Is this your only child?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: １歳のお子様と２４時間休み無く育児され、かつ家事もこなされているんですね。
dialogue.English: So you're raising a one-year-old child 24 hours a day without a break, while also managing all the housework.

dialogue.content: 今、どなたか手伝ってくれる方はいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone helping you out right now?

dialogue.content: あんまりいないです
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 旦那様はいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you have a husband?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも仕事が忙しくほとんど家にいないです
dialogue.English: But he's busy with work and is hardly ever home.

dialogue.content: もう疲れたので、子どもと二人でいなくなろうかと思ってます
dialogue.English: I’m so exhausted that I’m thinking about disappearing with my child, just the two of us.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そう思うに至るまでに頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You must have been pushing yourself so hard to get to the point of thinking that.

dialogue.content: 周りの人が普通にやってることです
dialogue.English: It's what everyone else does without any problem.

dialogue.content: でも自分はそんなこともできないなんて
dialogue.English: But I can't even handle that,

dialogue.content: 情けなくなります
dialogue.English: and it makes me feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。相談者様のお子様は、男の子ですか？女の子ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is your child a boy or a girl?

dialogue.content: 女の子です
dialogue.English: A girl.

dialogue.content: 相談者様の作ったご飯を食べたりされていますか？
dialogue.English: Does she eat the meals you make?

dialogue.content: はい、してます
dialogue.English: Yes, she does.

dialogue.content: お子様は笑顔になる時がありますか？
dialogue.English: Does your daughter smile sometimes?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのお子様の笑顔を作れるのは、相談者様だけです。
dialogue.English: You're the only one who can bring that smile to her face.

dialogue.content: 相談者様の育児と家事の毎日の辛さを、これまでどなたかにお話されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked with anyone about how hard the daily childcare and housework have been for you?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 話しても、疲れがとれるわけではないので…
dialogue.English: Because even if I talk about it, it won't make the exhaustion go away...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。何かこれまで、疲れをとるための工夫をしてこられたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you tried doing anything to relieve your exhaustion?

dialogue.content: いろいろ試しても、日常に戻るとまた同じ気持ちになってしまいます
dialogue.English: I've tried various things, but when I return to my daily life, I just end up feeling the same way again.

dialogue.content: どんなことを試してこられたのですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things have you tried?

dialogue.content: 一人でお風呂に浸かったり、音楽を聴いたり…
dialogue.English: Soaking in the bath by myself, listening to music...

dialogue.content: はい（聞いています）
dialogue.English: I see. (I’m listening.)

dialogue.content: 息抜きは大事っていうけど、日常に戻ったらまたこの毎日か…とおもい、死にたくなります
dialogue.English: People say it's important to take a break, but when I return to my routine, I just think, 'It's back to this every day...' and it makes me want to die.

dialogue.content: ダメなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that wrong?

dialogue.content: 旦那様だけでなく、ご両親など、今のあなたのつらい状況を支えてくれそうな人は思い浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: Besides your husband, can you think of anyone else, like your parents, who might be able to support you in your current difficult situation?

dialogue.content: 両親はいないので、他には、あまり浮かんでこないです…
dialogue.English: My parents are no longer around, so... I can't really think of anyone else.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。旦那様に、電話ででもお話できそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think you could talk to your husband, even just over the phone?

dialogue.content: 電話ですか？
dialogue.English: On the phone?

dialogue.content: 直接ご相談できるなら一番ですが、お話出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: It would be best if you could talk in person, but do you think you could speak with him?

dialogue.content: 相談したことはありますが、無理しないでいいよ、と言うだけで
dialogue.English: I've talked to him before, but he just says, 'Don't push yourself too hard,' and that's it.

dialogue.content: それ以外は何も…
dialogue.English: Nothing else...

dialogue.content: なので話してもなにも変わらないって思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: So I feel like talking to him won't change anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはお辛いですよね。一番、理解して欲しいと思いますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult. He's the one person you want to understand you the most, isn't he?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それで孤独を感じるのもあります
dialogue.English: That's part of the reason I feel so lonely.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。寂しく感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It must make you feel lonely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家事や育児を頑張っていることを、
dialogue.English: The fact that you’re working so hard with housework and childcare,

dialogue.content: 一番理解して欲しい旦那様に、相談した時にそのような対応を取られると、疲れも倍増してしまうと思います、
dialogue.English: when the person you most want to understand—your husband—responds that way after you reach out, I imagine it must double your exhaustion.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: 旦那様が向き合ってくれることが、相談者様の楽になる一つに思えますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: It seems that having your husband truly face this situation with you might be one thing that could ease your burden. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 旦那様に一日育児を経験もらうなど、相談者様の同じ時間を共有することが一つあるようですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: One possibility is to have your husband experience a full day of childcare, so he can share the same experience you have. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 一人でやってもらうってことですか？
dialogue.English: You mean have him do it by himself?

dialogue.content: まずは１時間だけ、など少しずつ共有していくのも一つかも知れません。
dialogue.English: Starting with just an hour or so, and gradually sharing the experience, might be a good approach.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: わかりました。やってみたいとおもいま
dialogue.English: Okay. I'd like to try that.

dialogue.content: す
今日は、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 今回、時間になってしまいました。相談者様の心の負担が少しでも楽になれますように思っております。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up for today. I hope that your emotional burden feels even a little lighter. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （今日は、ありがとうございました。「死にたい」との言葉で、混乱でした。すみませんでした。とても勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. I was flustered by the words 'I want to die.' I apologize. It was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. It was a learning experience for me too.)

dialogue.content: （では、失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Well then, I'll sign off now.)
